doc: F1/F2 distances (in cell units) to a jittered 8x8 grid that wraps on a 64x64 tile, at texel centers: the 3x3 neighborhood search, the wrapped jitter lookup (index % freq) and the unwrapped distance. The center coordinate is ((i + 0.5) / size) * freq, in that order. The jitter grid the seed draws is the input plan0.jitter (freq, freq, 2: [row][col][x, y] offset inside the cell). Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 7.1e-15 over the seven worley cases (6.7e-13 relative on values above 1e-3), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute; F1 and F2 are continuous in the jitter, no tie flips.
